title: Tesla reportedly flew scalar-powered vehicles

tellings.quote: >> I think he actually I think he actually flew some rumor has it.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla is rumored to have actually flown vehicles powered by scalar energy, a proposed kind of energy field outside mainstream physics. A scientist named Steve Colbern, who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, says this to Michels, and presents it only as a rumor. If true, it would mean such a craft was flown more than a century ago.
